notes: The hiphil יֹּסֶף is read as an auxiliary verb whose whole contribution the ASV writes as the adverb again (rule 56); folding again into the following infinitive was rejected because a written verb answers to it.
לַ before חֲרוֹת is unrepresented because the ASV recasts the infinitive as the finite was kindled and writes no word for the preposition (rules 40, 52).
